message: 花を摘みに

name: Carat
message: 「Meow!」
The demons retreated in an orderly fashion.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now nothing stands in the way of our victory road!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't get carried away.」

name: Sally
message: 「It's all thanks to special training from me, the idol of the Demon World! Show some gratitude.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn? Is something wrong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Thinking they pulled back pretty easily considering how tough a fight they put up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now that you mention it, that's true.」

name: Misa
message: 「Perhaps it's because they realized they couldn't win.」

name: Synn
message: 「We definitely had the upper hand, but... don't they usually fight a lot longer than this?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, they do.」

name: Synn
message: 「Almost like... they already achieved their goal.」

name: Sally
message: 「No way. We don't think about complicated stuff like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not sure using Sally as the standard is a good idea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka? Is something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing.」

name: Synn
message: 「You seem like you're in a bad mood, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's nothing, really. Just, shut up.」
Her eyes looked at me for just a split second before quickly darting away, looking feverish and moist,
and for some reason, my heart skipped a beat and I looked away too.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if it's nothing, that's fine, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Shut up! It's nothing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I'm gonna make a quick stop before heading back, sorry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka......」
I wonder what's wrong.
Could it be about the kiss...... No.
The way she's acting today is different from that.
I just hope she hasn't been pushing herself too hard and gotten sick......

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong with me...... Synn talking to a girl is nothing out of the ordinary......」
「Fufu...... Just as I thought......」
